Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Content: In guest mode, PlanIt stores the schedule locally on the device. After sign-in, schedules synchronize with Firebase and also retain a local copy.
Privacy.section2Content: PlanIt supports email and password, Google Sign-In, and Apple Sign-In on compatible platforms. Authentication data is handled by Firebase Authentication.
Privacy.section3Content: Native builds include Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, and Google Mobile Ads. The full policy describes device data, advertising identifiers, third-party services, retention, and user rights.
Privacy.officialDocument: Open the application's full privacy policy

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Content: PlanIt is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. The service or individual features may be changed or discontinued.
Terms.section2Content: Users are responsible for the legality of information they add to schedules, including teacher contacts, links, and notes. Important data should also be backed up independently.
Terms.section3Content: PlanIt may be available through web and native platform distribution channels. Availability can vary by platform and region.
Terms.officialDocument: Open the application's full terms of service

CookieConsent.title: We value your privacy
CookieConsent.description: We use optional cookies and Firebase Analytics only to understand site traffic and improve PlanIt. Analytics stays off unless you accept.

FAQ.title: What to know about PlanIt.
FAQ.author: PlanIt is made by Artomk, an independent developer from Ukraine.
FAQ.support: Still have questions? Get in touch

price.question: Is PlanIt free? Are there ads or a subscription?
price.answer: PlanIt is currently free. Advertising is planned across all platforms. We plan to introduce a subscription later; its price, features and terms will be shown before you subscribe.

account.question: Do I need to create an account?
account.answer: No. Choose “Continue as guest” on the sign-in screen. Guest data stays on that device. Signing in is required for sync across devices, cloud features and creating sharing codes.

start.question: How do I start if my group already has a schedule?
start.answer: If someone has created the schedule in PlanIt, ask for a code or link and import a copy in the app. Or create your own: set class times, breaks and the week cycle, then add subjects. You do not have to fill in every optional field at once.

offline.question: Can I use PlanIt without an internet connection?
offline.answer: On Android, your schedule is stored on the device and is available locally. Loading the web app, signing in, syncing and downloading cloud files require an internet connection. Whether a file is available offline depends on whether a copy is already on your device.

ios.question: Does PlanIt work on iPhone and iPad?
ios.answer: Yes, through the web app in your browser. The native app is currently published on Google Play for Android. We are preparing the iOS version, with no confirmed release date yet.

reminders.question: Where do reminders and the widget work?
reminders.answer: System class reminders and the home-screen widget are available in the Android app. Reminders require notification permission. The web app does not send system reminders or provide the Android widget.

sharing.question: Will the author’s changes automatically update my imported schedule?
sharing.answer: No. The recipient saves a separate copy. After signing in, the author can create a code or link valid for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days. A new copy can be shared after changes. Tasks and cloud attachments are not included in the shared code.

files.question: Can I attach PDFs and photos, or import a schedule from a file?
files.answer: You can attach photos, PDFs, other files and links to classes and tasks. Local files stay on the device; cloud storage requires signing in. Export to PDF, Word, Excel, CSV or text helps you print or edit a schedule. Attaching or exporting a file does not mean automatically recognizing or importing a schedule from a PDF or photo.

demo.question: Will changes from the website demos transfer to the app?
demo.answer: The demos are interactive examples. “Save” keeps changes only within the current demo. They do not transfer to the app and reset when you reload the page. You create your own schedule in the full web app.

privacy.question: Where is my data stored, and how can I delete it?
privacy.answer: Guest schedules are stored locally and can be lost if storage is cleared or the app is removed. After signing in, data is synced through Firebase. Technical services, advertising and analytics have separate data-processing terms. The documents section includes the privacy policy and account-deletion instructions.
